title: LEAP: a Latent Embedding Anomaly Patch-Transformer for time-series anomaly detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.35190v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time-series anomaly detection is dominated by reconstruction-based neural detectors, whose objective is structurally flawed. Since the target is also the input, an expressive model can learn to reconstruct anomalies too, leaving uninformative residuals. Recent large-scale benchmarks show that, on curated data, elaborate deep detectors rarely beat simple statistical baselines, while current leaders rely on representation learning. We propose LEAP (Latent Embedding Anomaly Patch-Transformer), which combines masked prediction with latent representation-based anomaly evidence, without relying on reconstruction or attention-based scoring. The model removes patches from a window and predicts them from the remaining temporal and cross-channel context, so prediction errors measure how well learned dynamics explain hidden segments. translated_title: LEAP：一种用于时间序列异常检测的潜在嵌入异常补丁Transformer
translated_abstract: 时间序列异常检测目前主要被基于重构的神经检测器所主导，但这类方法的目标函数存在结构性缺陷。由于预测目标同时也是输入，表达能力强的模型可以学会重构异常本身，从而留下无信息量的残差。近期的大规模基准测试表明，在精选数据上，复杂的深度检测器很少能胜过简单的统计基线方法，而当前的领先方法则依赖于表示学习。我们提出了LEAP（潜在嵌入异常补丁Transformer），它将掩码预测与基于潜在表示的异常证据相结合，而不依赖重构或基于注意力的评分。该模型从时间窗口中移除补丁，并根据剩余的时间上下文和跨通道上下文来预测它们，因此预测误差可以衡量学习到的动态规律对隐藏片段的解释能力。确定性的互补分组掩码机制确保每个时间步在隐藏状态下都能被评分，且可见帧保持一致
tldr: 提出LEAP模型，将掩码预测与潜在表示相结合进行时间序列异常检测，避免了基于重构方法的结构性缺陷，无需依赖重构误差或注意力评分。
en_tdlr: LEAP combines masked prediction with latent representation-based anomaly evidence for time-series anomaly detection, overcoming the structural flaws of reconstruction-based methods without relying on reconstruction error or attention-based scoring.
